title: The ratelimit-service schema.
description: JSON Schema for the ratelimit-service chart. The root stays open: the platform passes one parameter set to every chart of the application, so the operator chart's blocks reach this schema and are ignored. The blocks this chart reads are closed.

SERVICE_NAME.title: Service name
SERVICE_NAME.description: Platform parameter. The name of the service's Deployment and ServiceAccount, and its app.kubernetes.io/name and name labels. The Service keeps its fixed name, ratelimit: a satellite's filters compute the RLS address from it and cannot know how the baseline was named. It is also the microserviceName of the counter store's DBaaS classifier.

NAMESPACE.title: Namespace
NAMESPACE.description: Platform parameter. The namespace every object of the chart lands in; empty is the release namespace.

APPLICATION_NAME.title: Application name
APPLICATION_NAME.description: Platform parameter. The value of the app.kubernetes.io/part-of label.

MANAGED_BY.title: Managed by
MANAGED_BY.description: Platform parameter. The value of the app.kubernetes.io/managed-by label; empty is Helm.

ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.title: Artifact descriptor version
ARTIFACT_DESCRIPTOR_VERSION.description: Platform parameter. The value of the app.kubernetes.io/version label; empty is the chart's appVersion.

DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.title: Deployment session
DEPLOYMENT_SESSION_ID.description: Platform parameter. The deployment.netcracker.com/sessionId label of the Deployment; empty is unimplemented.

PAAS_PLATFORM.title: PaaS platform
PAAS_PLATFORM.description: Platform parameter. On KUBERNETES the container runs as group 10001 and may have a read-only root filesystem; on OPENSHIFT the platform assigns both.

READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.title: Read-only root filesystem
READONLY_CONTAINER_FILE_SYSTEM_ENABLED.description: Platform parameter. Mounts the container's root filesystem read-only on KUBERNETES.

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.title: Deployment strategy
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_TYPE.description: Platform parameter. Empty and ramped_slow_rollout replace one pod at a time and keep the old one until the new one is Ready; recreate and best_effort_controlled_rollout stop the old pods first, which leaves the gateways without an RLS endpoint for the rollout.

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_MAXSURGE.title: Max surge
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_MAXSURGE.description: Platform parameter. maxSurge of custom_rollout; 25% when unset.

DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_MAXUNAVAILABLE.title: Max unavailable
DEPLOYMENT_STRATEGY_MAXUNAVAILABLE.description: Platform parameter. maxUnavailable of custom_rollout; 25% when unset.

IMAGE_REPOSITORY.title: Image repository
IMAGE_REPOSITORY.description: Platform parameter. The repository of the image.

TAG.title: Image tag
TAG.description: Platform parameter. The tag of the image; empty is the chart's appVersion.

LOG_LEVEL.title: Log level
LOG_LEVEL.description: Platform parameter. The root level of the platform logger, passed as LOGGING_LEVEL_ROOT in lower case.

redis.title: Counter store
redis.description: Redis holds the counters, in a database DBaaS provisions for the release through its Redis adapter. The replicas read its connection from the Secret <SERVICE_NAME>-redis that dbaas-operator writes for the chart's DatabaseSecretClaim.

enabled.description: Render the InternalDatabase and the DatabaseSecretClaim. false expects the Secret <SERVICE_NAME>-redis, with connectionProperties.json in DBaaS's format, to be provided otherwise, as on a test cluster without DBaaS.

API_DBAAS_ADDRESS.title: DBaaS aggregator address
API_DBAAS_ADDRESS.description: Address of dbaas-aggregator, http://<aggregator>.<namespace>:<port>. Shared platform parameter; the namespace in its host is the dbaas-operator the chart's InternalDatabase and DatabaseSecretClaim are assigned to.

port.description: Plain HTTP, cluster-internal. Published on the Service under the name metrics: the operator takes the port number from the EndpointSlice by that name and reads /debug/applied on it.

nearLimitRatio.description: Share of the capacity of a rule's window consumed before an admission counts as near-limit, the burst of a GCRA window or the requests of a fixed one; a ratio in (0, 1).

MONITORING_ENABLED.title: The MONITORING_ENABLED schema
MONITORING_ENABLED.description: Set to true to render the PodMonitor and the Grafana dashboard of the service. Requires the monitoring and grafana operators' CRDs on the target cluster.

alerts.title: Alert rules
alerts.description: The PrometheusRule of the chart, rendered with MONITORING_ENABLED; the thresholds and hold durations the expressions read.

enabled.description: Render the PrometheusRule of the data plane. Read only with MONITORING_ENABLED.

latencyBudgetSeconds.description: The p99 of a check, in seconds, above which RatelimitDecisionLatencyHigh fires. A value at or below zero would render a comparison every check satisfies.

latencyFor.description: How long the p99 stays above the budget before RatelimitDecisionLatencyHigh fires.

unknownDomainFor.description: How long unknown-domain checks keep arriving before RatelimitUnknownDomain fires.

storeErrorsFor.description: How long store errors keep arriving before RatelimitStoreErrors fires. At least the 5m window of the expression, or a single error fires the alert while it still fills the window.

keyNotExtractedFor.description: How long a declared key stays at zero extractions next to tokens before RatelimitKeyDeclaredNotExtracted fires.

domainBudgetWarnAt.description: The worst-case decision buckets of a domain at which RatelimitDomainBudgetNearLimit fires; the budget is 128.

configAbsentFor.description: How long a replica finds no manifest in its mounted configuration before RatelimitConfigurationAbsent fires.

ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.title: Private gateway name
ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME.description: Name of the private Istio gateway: the default principal the management AuthorizationPolicy allows. Shared deployment parameter: must equal ISTIO_PRIVATE_GATEWAY_NAME in qubership-core-mesh-config, which creates the Gateway.

name.description: Defaults to the chart's fullname when empty.

CLOUD_TOPOLOGY_KEY.title: Topology key
CLOUD_TOPOLOGY_KEY.description: Platform parameter. The node label the pods spread over when CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES is not set.

CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.title: Topologies
CLOUD_TOPOLOGIES.description: Platform parameter. One topology spread constraint per entry; it replaces CLOUD_TOPOLOGY_KEY.

MEMORY_REQUEST.title: The MEMORY_REQUEST schema
MEMORY_REQUEST.description: Defines minimum amount of memory the container will use to start

management.title: Management API
management.description: The operator interface. The port and its AuthorizationPolicy belong together: the service does not verify the token signature, so the policy is what keeps the endpoints off the rest of the mesh.

allowedServiceAccounts.description: Service accounts allowed to reach the port, in the release namespace. Empty means the private gateway alone.

claims.title: Identity claims
claims.description: The claims the subject and the roles are read from. Both accept a dotted path for a nested claim, such as realm_access.roles.

roles.title: Role mapping
roles.description: The role names the IdP issues, mapped onto viewer and operator. With at least one list set, a role on neither list grants nothing. Both lists empty is a different thing: the mapping is off and the token's roles are read as they are, which is the canonical names. The schema refuses that combination so it cannot happen by accident; a read-only deployment sets viewer and leaves operator empty.

BASELINE_ORIGIN.title: Baseline origin namespace
BASELINE_ORIGIN.description: Set by the platform on a satellite namespace of a composite, naming the baseline's origin namespace. Empty means this release is a standalone installation or the baseline itself. When set, this chart renders nothing: a satellite runs no service, its gateway filters send checks to the baseline's.

BASELINE_CONTROLLER.title: Baseline controller namespace
BASELINE_CONTROLLER.description: Read for parity with control-plane and the operator chart; it changes no object of this chart. On this platform the baseline is never blue-green'd, so the platform leaves it empty.
